versions.content: Development Errors for other Parameters Unless otherwise covered by [SWS_BswM_00321], [SWS_BswM_00322], [SWS_BswM_00323]: If the BswMDevErrorDetect switch is enabled, APIs provided by the BswM accepting parameters shall check the parameters for being in the allowed range. If not, the API shall report BSWM_E_PARAM_INVALID to the Default Error Tracer.
